status: post hoc: designed after Q1A_V3(+AMEND1) META_LEARNING_UNNECESSARY and Q1A_V4 (RESIDUAL_BETTER / STRUCTURE_MATTERS / AUTO_SHRINK_FAILS), all on ETTh1/ETTh2 with TQNet. Frozen before any v5 formal run; only 1-epoch smoke tests (smoke_v5a/, smoke_v5b/) were run, used for engineering checks, timing and memory only, and are excluded from all analyses.

questions.Q5.0: On which further datasets/horizons does the released QDF reproduce a gain over its paired Sigma = I control at all (this defines the analysis cells)?
questions.Q5.1: In those cells, does the closed-form plug-in Sigma = I + a*S0n with validation-selected a recover the QDF gain (generalisation of the v3 verdict)?
questions.Q5.2: Is the residual second moment better than the label covariance (generalisation of v4 Q4.1)?
questions.Q5.3: Do the eigen-directions matter, not only the spectrum (generalisation of v4 Q4.2)?

platform: AutoDL (Chongqing A / machine 703), RTX 4080 SUPER 32 GB, 16 vCPU quota, cgroup memory.high 60 GiB, torch 2.13.0+cu130, /root/miniconda3/bin/python. Every run of v5 executes on this GPU; nothing is mixed with CPU runs. OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 per job; jobs run in parallel under a resident-memory reservation (run_grid_v5.MEM_GB, budget 50 GB), because the released QDF code wraps each meta-task DataLoader in itertools.cycle and therefore caches the whole training set in host memory (unchanged, to stay faithful to the release).
backbone_and_hyperparameters: TQNet with the QDF release's own per-dataset scripts (scripts/{ETTm1,ETTm2,Weather,ECL}.sh at commit eb0693a9): learning_rate = inner_lr, meta_lr, warmup_steps, num_tasks, meta_inner_steps per (dataset, pred_len) as in run_grid_v5.HP; batch_size 32 (ECL 16), dropout 0.5 (ECL 0.0), cycle 96/96/144/168, seq_len 96, lradj type1, train_epochs 30, patience 5, test_batch_size 1, first_order 1, overlap_ratio 0, num_workers 0. Identical across arms except the Sigma treatment.
data: ETTm1/ETTm2 from the repository's ETT-small; weather.csv (sha256 9b2b19b1...) and electricity.csv (sha256 7e45845d...) from hf-mirror AutonLab/Timeseries-PILE forecasting/autoformer (the standard Autoformer files; ETTh1/ETTh2 from the same source are value-identical to ours).

excluded_cells.ECL-720: one ECL-720 job needs about 38 GB resident memory (itertools.cycle cache), so it can only run alone; 30+ runs would take more than a day. Not run in v5.

stages.A: all 7 cells x 3 seeds, arms QDF, SIGMA_I, SIGMA_I_REP, PLUGIN_A<a> for a in a_grid (10 arms, 210 runs).
stages.B: only after stage A is complete, only in the analysis cells defined below: COVY_A<a> for a in a_grid and SPECTRUM_RANDOM (8 arms x 3 seeds per analysis cell). If no cell qualifies, stage B is not run.

arms.QDF: released QDF (meta-learned Sigma), run_grid.qdf_cmd semantics with the v5 hyper-parameters
arms.SIGMA_I: same command with --meta_lr 0 (Sigma stays I; shares initialisation, meta-phase RNG consumption and batch order with QDF)
arms.SIGMA_I_REP: an exact repeat of SIGMA_I (same seed, same command) to measure GPU run-to-run nondeterminism
arms.PLUGIN_A<a>: as protocol_v3: SIGMA_I command, Sigma = I + a*S0n injected after the (meta_lr 0) meta phase, S0 = training-set second moment of the initial residual, S0n = S0*T/tr(S0)
arms.PLUGIN_VAL: derived as protocol_v3 (lowest best validation MSE over the 7 PLUGIN_A<a> runs, ties to the smaller a; test MSE never used)
arms.COVY_A<a>: as protocol_v4 (Sigma = I + a*Cyn, Cyn = Cov(Y_train)*T/tr)
arms.SPECTRUM_RANDOM: as protocol_v4 (eigenvalues of I + a*S0n with Haar-random eigenvectors, rotation seeded by the run seed), with a = the per-seed PLUGIN_VAL-selected a from stage A; matched comparator PLUGIN_A<same a>, same seed

quantities.R_X: mean g_X / mean g_QDF per cell
quantities.nu: GPU noise per cell: mean over seeds of |MSE_SIGMA_I_REP - MSE_SIGMA_I| / MSE_SIGMA_I

analysis_cells: a cell is an analysis cell iff g_QDF > 0 for 3/3 seeds and mean g_QDF >= max(0.005, 3*nu). Fixed from stage A before stage B is launched; the other cells are reported descriptively.

Q5.0.QDF_EFFECT_REPRODUCED_IN_n_CELLS: report n and the list; if n < 2 the Q5.1-Q5.3 verdicts are INSUFFICIENT_CELLS

Q5.1.META_LEARNING_UNNECESSARY_GENERALISES: in >= k analysis cells: R_PLUGIN_VAL >= 0.8 and g_PLUGIN_VAL > 0 for 3/3 seeds

Q5.2.LABEL_COV_EQUIVALENT: in >= k analysis cells: R_COVY_VAL >= 0.8 and |mean D_label| <= 0.25 * mean g_QDF
Q5.2.RESIDUAL_BETTER: in >= k analysis cells: mean D_label > 0.25 * mean g_QDF and D_label > 0 for 3/3 seeds
Q5.2.LABEL_BETTER: in >= k analysis cells: mean D_label < -0.25 * mean g_QDF and D_label < 0 for 3/3 seeds

Q5.3.STRUCTURE_MATTERS: in >= k analysis cells: R_SPECTRUM_RANDOM < 0.5 and D_struct > 0 for 3/3 seeds

decision_rules.order: Q5.2 rules are checked in the listed order (as v4)
decision_rules.secondary: per cell: g_QDF per seed, nu, every PLUGIN_A<a> and COVY_A<a> R with bands RECOVERS (>= 0.8) / PARTIAL / FAILS (< 0.5), selected vs oracle a, cos(S0, Cy), run times; descriptive cells reported with the same table but no verdict. Shape of the learned QDF Sigma vs S0n (and S0n + Diag S0n), as analyze_sigma_shape.py, from the kept QDF A.pth and PLUGIN_A1 sigma_target.npy: descriptive.

engineering_check: smoke_v5a/ (QDF 1 epoch, all 8 cells, seed 2021) and smoke_v5b/ (PLUGIN_A0.25, COVY_A0.25 and SPECTRUM_RANDOM at a=0.25 on GPU, 1 epoch): returncode 0, test MSE parsed, sigma_target.json written with inject_max_abs_err < 1e-3, spectrum relative error < 1e-6; peak resident memory measured by remote/mem_poll.sh. smoke_v5a was stopped at 5/11 runs when two concurrent ECL-720 jobs hit the container memory limit; this motivated the memory reservation and the ECL-720 exclusion.
code: run_grid_v5.py (--stage A|B), fixed_sigma_patch.py (GPU device fixes only: moments moved to CPU before accumulation; no change of the estimators), summarize_v5.py -> results/summary_v5.json; runs appended to results/runs_v5.jsonl, work dirs runs_v5/.
integrity: all runs (including failures) appended to results/runs_v5.jsonl; failures rerun only through the resumable runner; verdicts only from summarize_v5.py; anything else is a new, post hoc labelled analysis.
